profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is recorded as a public company trading under the ticker AI, headquartered in Redwood City, California, with CIK 0001577526. The website field associated with the company points to airliquide.com, and the text harvested from that site describes Air Liquide rather than C3.ai. In that text, Air Liquide describes itself as a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare, saying it serves 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees.

The same harvested text states that Air Liquide, the École normale supérieure and its Foundation announced the creation of a research chair titled "Artificial intelligence for chemistry and through chemistry." No AI products are tracked for C3.ai in the held facts, and no MCP servers or lawsuits are recorded for it.

The held record lists California as a jurisdiction of law exposure with a count of 281, and lists no individual cases.
